articles.summary: Pali Lehohla, former Statistician-General of South Africa and founder of the Pan-African Institute of Evidence, joins us to discuss what the data reveals about the state of South Africa’s democracy - and why he believes the numbers now point to its collapse.
articles.title: The Smokeless Word - Pali Lehohla
